subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo / tech deep dive

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo / tech deep dive

Hi Alex —

Great talking earlier — thanks for sharing the priorities (high-throughput search queries, stricter PII controls, and predictable latency). Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- Recap: you want to evaluate Redwood for serving search-weighted LLM completions and embeddings for product search and suggestions.
- Success criteria: <=150ms median latency for 512-token requests, SOC2-compliant data handling, and predictable cost < $0.02/request at scale.
- Next step: 60-minute demo + tech deep dive with Rafael to validate latency targets and discuss deployment (Hosted vs Dedicated).

Here are three slots I can offer next week (all PT):
- Tue, Dec 8 — 11:00 AM
- Wed, Dec 9 — 10:00 AM
- Thu, Dec 10 — 2:00 PM

Who from your side should join the demo? I suggest including your engineering lead and SRE — that will help Rafael answer the deep technical questions.

I've attached our sales deck for context. Once you confirm a preferred slot and attendee list I’ll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-sales-deck.pdf

We’ll take Tue, Dec 8 at 11:00 AM PT. Attendees:
- Alex Johnson — Product Manager

- Mark Chen — SRE

Best,
Alex
